# Load Data and Libraries

```{r}

# Libraries
library(tidyverse)

# Data
main <- read_csv("~/Documents/Sports Analytics/2026 CMSAC RRC/full_data.csv")

```

# Bounds Calculation

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(sf)
library(gganimate)
library(patchwork)

# =============================================================================
# 0. CONFIG 
# =============================================================================

INPUT_PHASE_VALUES <- c("pre_pass") # ONLY pre-pass frames used
VALID_PASS_RESULTS <- c("C") # Include incomplete passes to avoid target bias
FRAME_RATE_HZ      <- 10 # Standard NGS tracking frame rate (10 fps)

# Lookahead evaluation horizon grid (frames ahead to project/evaluate)
frames_ahead_grid <- seq(5, 30, by = 5) 

# =============================================================================
# 1. Data Cleaning & Line of Scrimmage / Route Depth Calculation
# =============================================================================

frame_col <- intersect(c("frame_id", "frameId", "frame", "frame_number"), names(main))[1]
pos_col   <- intersect(c("player_position", "position", "officialPosition"), names(main))[1]

los_col <- "los_x_std"

if (is.na(los_col)) {
  stop("Could not auto-detect Line of Scrimmage column. Set `los_col <- 'column_name'` manually.")
}

# Filter strictly to pre_pass tracking data
main_prepass <- main %>%
  filter(phase %in% INPUT_PHASE_VALUES) %>%
  arrange(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, .data[[frame_col]]) %>%
  group_by(game_id, play_id, nfl_id) %>%
  mutate(global_frame = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Identify the distribution of the pass depth using final pre pass location
pass_depth_df <- main_prepass %>%
  filter(
    player_role == "Targeted Receiver",
    pass_result %in% VALID_PASS_RESULTS,
    play_nullified_by_penalty == "N"
  ) %>%
  group_by(game_id, play_id, nfl_id) %>%
  summarise(
    throw_frame     = max(global_frame),
    anchor_x        = x_std[global_frame == max(global_frame)],
    los_x_std       = first(los_x_std), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(anchor_x), !is.na(los_x_std)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    route_depth_yds = anchor_x - los_x_std,
  ) %>%
  select(route_depth_yds)

depth_std_dev <- sd(pass_depth_df$route_depth_yds, na.rm = TRUE)
depth_mean <- mean(pass_depth_df$route_depth_yds, na.rm = TRUE)
plus1_std_dev <- depth_mean + depth_std_dev
minus1_std_dev <- depth_mean - depth_std_dev

# Filter plays with valid coordinates and compute LOS depth
throw_frames <- main_prepass %>%
  filter(
    player_role == "Targeted Receiver",
    pass_result %in% VALID_PASS_RESULTS,
    play_nullified_by_penalty == "N"
  ) %>%
  group_by(game_id, play_id, nfl_id) %>%
  summarise(
    throw_frame     = max(global_frame),
    anchor_x        = x_std[global_frame == max(global_frame)],
    anchor_y        = y_std[global_frame == max(global_frame)],
    max_x_prepass   = max(x_std, na.rm = TRUE),
    los_x_std       = first(los_x_std),
    ball_land_x_std = first(ball_land_x_std),
    ball_land_y_std = first(ball_land_y_std),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ball_land_x_std), !is.na(ball_land_y_std),
    !is.na(anchor_x), !is.na(anchor_y), !is.na(los_x_std)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    route_depth_yds = anchor_x - los_x_std,
    pass_depth_bin  = cut(
      route_depth_yds, 
      breaks = c(-Inf, minus1_std_dev, plus1_std_dev, Inf),
      labels = c("Short", "Medium", "Deep")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pass_depth_bin))

cat("Valid plays available for calibration:", nrow(throw_frames), "\n")
stopifnot("No valid plays found in pre_pass dataset." = nrow(throw_frames) > 0)

# =============================================================================
# 2. Geometry Builder with Conditional Last-Movement Extrapolation
# =============================================================================

full_route_path <- main_prepass %>%
  select(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, global_frame, x_std, y_std) %>%
  inner_join(
    throw_frames %>% select(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, throw_frame),
    by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id")
  ) %>%
  filter(global_frame <= throw_frame) %>%
  arrange(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, global_frame) %>%
  distinct(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, global_frame, .keep_all = TRUE)

build_path_geometry <- function(n_frames_ahead) {

  path_pts <- full_route_path %>%
    arrange(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, global_frame) %>%
    group_by(game_id, play_id, nfl_id) %>%
    summarise(
      px = list(x_std), 
      py = list(y_std), 
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  df <- throw_frames %>%
    inner_join(path_pts, by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id"))

  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  pmap_dfr(df, function(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, anchor_x, anchor_y,
                        ball_land_x_std, ball_land_y_std, px, py, ...) {

    path_x <- unlist(px)
    path_y <- unlist(py)
    n_pts  <- length(path_x)
    
    if (n_pts < 2) return(NULL) 

    # 1. Compute velocity vector from last movement step (frame n-1 to n)
    dx_last <- path_x[n_pts] - path_x[n_pts - 1]
    dy_last <- path_y[n_pts] - path_y[n_pts - 1]
    step_speed <- sqrt(dx_last^2 + dy_last^2)

    # 2. Compute projected forward segment length from anchor
    proj_len <- step_speed * n_frames_ahead
    extrap_x <- anchor_x + (if (step_speed > 1e-4) dx_last / step_speed else 0) * proj_len
    extrap_y <- anchor_y + (if (step_speed > 1e-4) dy_last / step_speed else 0) * proj_len

    # 3. Target distance to the forward projection line segment
    bx <- ball_land_x_std; by <- ball_land_y_std
    seg_dx <- extrap_x - anchor_x
    seg_dy <- extrap_y - anchor_y
    denom  <- seg_dx^2 + seg_dy^2

    t <- if (denom > 0) pmin(pmax(((bx - anchor_x) * seg_dx + (by - anchor_y) * seg_dy) / denom, 0), 1) else 0
    proj_x <- anchor_x + t * seg_dx
    proj_y <- anchor_y + t * seg_dy
    dist   <- sqrt((bx - proj_x)^2 + (by - proj_y)^2)
    arc_along <- t * proj_len

    # 4. Backward projection relative to release unit vector
    ux <- if (step_speed > 1e-4) dx_last / step_speed else 0
    uy <- if (step_speed > 1e-4) dy_last / step_speed else 0
    vx0 <- bx - anchor_x; vy0 <- by - anchor_y
    back_along <- -(vx0 * ux + vy0 * uy)
    back_perp  <- sqrt(pmax(vx0^2 + vy0^2 - back_along^2, 0))

    tibble(
      game_id    = game_id, 
      play_id    = play_id, 
      nfl_id     = nfl_id,
      min_dist   = dist, 
      arc_along  = arc_along,
      proj_len   = proj_len,      # ONLY projected forward length from throw
      back_along = back_along, 
      back_perp  = back_perp
    )
  })
}

# =============================================================================
# 3. Dynamic Envelope Evaluation (Duplicate-Safe)
# =============================================================================

evaluate_bw <- function(geom, backward_cushion, corridor_width, frames_ahead) {
  
  if (!"pass_depth_bin" %in% names(geom)) {
    geom <- geom %>%
      inner_join(
        throw_frames %>% select(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, pass_depth_bin), 
        by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id")
      )
  }

  geom <- geom %>%
    mutate(
      in_forward_tube  = min_dist <= corridor_width & arc_along >= 0 & arc_along <= proj_len,
      in_backward_zone = back_along >= 0 & back_along <= backward_cushion & back_perp <= corridor_width,
      inside           = in_forward_tube | in_backward_zone
    )

  geom %>%
    group_by(pass_depth_bin) %>%
    summarise(
      backward_cushion = backward_cushion,
      corridor_width   = corridor_width,
      frames_ahead     = frames_ahead,
      coverage         = mean(inside),
      mean_proj_len    = mean(proj_len),
      area             = 2 * corridor_width * (mean(proj_len) + backward_cushion) + pi * (corridor_width^2),
      n_plays          = n(),
      .groups          = "drop"
    )
}

# =============================================================================
# 4 & 5. Grid Search & Working Point Calibration (Depth-Stratified)
# =============================================================================

frames_ahead_grid <- seq(5, 35, by = 5)
geom_by_n <- setNames(purrr::map(frames_ahead_grid, build_path_geometry), frames_ahead_grid)

# Define depth-specific parameter search grids
grid_short <- expand.grid(
  target_bin       = "Short",
  backward_cushion = seq(0, 3, by = 0.5),
  corridor_width   = seq(1, 6, by = 0.5),
  frames_ahead     = seq(5, 15, by = 5),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

grid_medium <- expand.grid(
  target_bin       = "Medium",
  backward_cushion = seq(0, 3, by = 0.5),
  corridor_width   = seq(1, 6, by = 0.5),
  frames_ahead     = seq(10, 25, by = 5),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

grid_deep <- expand.grid(
  target_bin       = "Deep",
  backward_cushion = seq(0, 3, by = 0.5),
  corridor_width   = seq(1, 6, by = 0.5),
  frames_ahead     = seq(15, 35, by = 5),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

param_grid <- bind_rows(grid_short, grid_medium, grid_deep)

# Run Grid Search
results <- pmap_dfr(param_grid, function(target_bin, backward_cushion, corridor_width, frames_ahead) {
  geom <- geom_by_n[[as.character(frames_ahead)]]
  if (is.null(geom) || nrow(geom) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Join pass_depth_bin cleanly and filter to current depth bin
  geom_bin <- geom %>%
    inner_join(
      throw_frames %>% select(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, pass_depth_bin), 
      by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id")
    ) %>%
    filter(as.character(pass_depth_bin) == target_bin)
    
  if (nrow(geom_bin) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  evaluate_bw(geom_bin, backward_cushion, corridor_width, frames_ahead)
})

target_coverage <- 0.90

# Select optimal parameters reaching target coverage per bin
best_per_bin <- results %>% 
  filter(coverage >= target_coverage) %>% 
  group_by(pass_depth_bin) %>% 
  arrange(area) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Fallback mechanism if target coverage is unreachable
all_bins <- c("Short", "Medium", "Deep")
missing_bins <- setdiff(all_bins, as.character(best_per_bin$pass_depth_bin))

if (length(missing_bins) > 0) {
  fallback_bins <- results %>%
    filter(as.character(pass_depth_bin) %in% missing_bins) %>%
    group_by(pass_depth_bin) %>%
    arrange(desc(coverage), area) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()
    
  best_per_bin <- bind_rows(best_per_bin, fallback_bins)
}

# Enforce Monotonicity (Corridor width cannot shrink as route depth increases)
best_per_bin <- best_per_bin %>%
  mutate(pass_depth_bin = factor(pass_depth_bin, levels = all_bins)) %>%
  arrange(pass_depth_bin) %>%
  mutate(
    corridor_width = cummax(corridor_width)
  )

cat("\n=== STRATIFIED OPTIMAL PARAMETERS (MONOTONIC & CONDITIONAL) ===\n")
print(best_per_bin %>% select(pass_depth_bin, backward_cushion, corridor_width, frames_ahead, coverage, area))
cat("===============================================================\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# 6. Robustness Check & Depth Bin Plotting
# =============================================================================

all_geoms <- bind_rows(lapply(names(geom_by_n), function(f_ahead) {
  geom_by_n[[f_ahead]] %>% mutate(frames_ahead = as.numeric(f_ahead))
}))

play_results <- throw_frames %>%
  inner_join(best_per_bin, by = "pass_depth_bin") %>%
  inner_join(all_geoms, by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id", "frames_ahead")) %>%
  mutate(
    in_forward_tube  = min_dist <= corridor_width & arc_along >= 0 & arc_along <= proj_len,
    in_backward_zone = back_along >= 0 & back_along <= backward_cushion & back_perp <= corridor_width,
    inside           = in_forward_tube | in_backward_zone
  )

coverage_by_depth <- play_results %>%
  group_by(pass_depth_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    total_plays     = n(),
    opt_width       = mean(corridor_width),
    opt_cushion     = mean(backward_cushion),
    coverage_pct    = mean(inside),
    mean_area       = mean(area),
    .groups         = "drop"
  )

print(coverage_by_depth)

plot_depth <- ggplot(coverage_by_depth, aes(x = pass_depth_bin, y = coverage_pct, fill = pass_depth_bin)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(coverage_pct, accuracy = 0.1)), vjust = -0.5, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = target_coverage, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1.05)) +
  labs(
    title = "Class-Balanced Target Envelope Coverage (Forward Area Only)",
    subtitle = "Projection evaluated strictly on forward trajectory from release point",
    x = "Route Depth at Release Relative to LOS (Yards)",
    y = "Coverage Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(plot_depth)

# =============================================================================
# 7. Pre-Pass Animation with Conditional Frame-by-Frame Extrapolation
# =============================================================================

sample_play_info <- throw_frames %>% head(1)
sample_game   <- sample_play_info$game_id
sample_play   <- sample_play_info$play_id
sample_target <- sample_play_info$nfl_id
sample_bin    <- sample_play_info$pass_depth_bin

sample_params <- best_per_bin %>% filter(pass_depth_bin == sample_bin)

dyn_b <- if (nrow(sample_params) > 0) sample_params$backward_cushion[1] else 1.0
dyn_w <- if (nrow(sample_params) > 0) sample_params$corridor_width[1]    else 3.0
dyn_f <- if (nrow(sample_params) > 0) sample_params$frames_ahead[1]      else 15

target_path <- main_prepass %>%
  filter(
    game_id == sample_game, 
    play_id == sample_play, 
    nfl_id == sample_target,
    !is.na(x_std), !is.na(y_std)
  ) %>%
  arrange(global_frame) %>%
  distinct(global_frame, .keep_all = TRUE)

get_frame_polygon <- function(player_path, current_frame, backward_cushion, corridor_width, frames_ahead) {
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Backwards Cushion (Instantaneous Vector at Current Frame)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  route_up_to_current <- player_path %>%
    filter(global_frame <= current_frame, !is.na(x_std), !is.na(y_std)) %>%
    arrange(global_frame)
  
  if (nrow(route_up_to_current) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  coords_current <- as.matrix(route_up_to_current[, c("x_std", "y_std")])
  n_pts_curr     <- nrow(coords_current)
  
  curr_pt <- coords_current[n_pts_curr, ]
  prev_pt <- coords_current[n_pts_curr - 1, ]
  
  dx_curr <- curr_pt[1] - prev_pt[1]
  dy_curr <- curr_pt[2] - prev_pt[2]
  step_speed_curr <- sqrt(dx_curr^2 + dy_curr^2)
  
  ux_curr <- if (step_speed_curr > 1e-4) dx_curr / step_speed_curr else 0
  uy_curr <- if (step_speed_curr > 1e-4) dy_curr / step_speed_curr else 0
  
  # Point extending backward from current position
  back_pt <- c(curr_pt[1] - ux_curr * backward_cushion, curr_pt[2] - uy_curr * backward_cushion)
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Forward Projection (Use Actual Frames if Available)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  target_end_frame <- current_frame + frames_ahead
  max_avail_frame  <- max(player_path$global_frame)
  actual_end_frame <- min(max_avail_frame, target_end_frame)
  
  # Grab actual coordinates from current frame up to the limit
  future_route <- player_path %>%
    filter(global_frame >= current_frame, global_frame <= actual_end_frame, !is.na(x_std), !is.na(y_std)) %>%
    arrange(global_frame)
    
  coords_future <- as.matrix(future_route[, c("x_std", "y_std")])
  
  # Start building the linestring coordinates: Back point + Actual Future Path
  poly_coords <- rbind(back_pt, coords_future)
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Conditional Extrapolation (If we run out of actual frames)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  frames_short <- target_end_frame - actual_end_frame
  
  if (frames_short > 0 && nrow(coords_future) >= 2) {
    # Calculate velocity based strictly on the LAST available movement
    n_pts_fut      <- nrow(coords_future)
    last_pt        <- coords_future[n_pts_fut, ]
    second_last_pt <- coords_future[n_pts_fut - 1, ]
    
    dx_last <- last_pt[1] - second_last_pt[1]
    dy_last <- last_pt[2] - second_last_pt[2]
    
    # Project forward the remaining missing frames
    extrap_pt <- c(last_pt[1] + dx_last * frames_short, last_pt[2] + dy_last * frames_short)
    
    poly_coords <- rbind(poly_coords, extrap_pt)
  }
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Generate the Envelope Buffer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  line_sf <- st_sfc(st_linestring(poly_coords))
  poly_sf <- st_buffer(line_sf, dist = corridor_width, endCapStyle = "ROUND", joinStyle = "ROUND")
  
  tibble(global_frame = current_frame, geometry = poly_sf)
}

# =============================================================================
# 8. Spatial Diagnostic Plots & Residual Analysis
# =============================================================================

residual_data <- play_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(min_dist), !is.na(route_depth_yds), !is.na(arc_along), !is.na(proj_len)) %>%
  arrange(route_depth_yds) %>%
  mutate(
    perp_residual = min_dist,
    long_residual = arc_along - proj_len
  )

cat("Valid plays available for residual analysis:", nrow(residual_data), "\n")

if (nrow(residual_data) > 0) {
  fit <- lm(perp_residual ~ route_depth_yds, data = residual_data, na.action = na.exclude)
  residual_data <- residual_data %>%
    mutate(linear_fit_res = residuals(fit))
} else {
  stop("`play_results` has 0 valid rows. Check join conditions.")
}

p_res_vs_depth <- ggplot(residual_data, aes(x = route_depth_yds, y = perp_residual)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_step(aes(y = corridor_width), color = "firebrick", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "darkblue", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Lateral Route Residuals vs. LOS Depth",
    subtitle = "Dashed line = Dynamic Corridor Width per pass depth bin",
    x = "Route Depth at Release Relative to LOS (Yards)",
    y = "Perpendicular Distance Error (Yards)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_res_density <- ggplot(residual_data, aes(x = perp_residual)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 35, fill = "slategray", alpha = 0.6, color = "white") +
  geom_density(color = "darkblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(data = best_per_bin, aes(xintercept = corridor_width, color = pass_depth_bin), 
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Distribution of Lateral Errors",
    subtitle = "Dashed lines = Optimal corridor widths for respective depth bins",
    x = "Perpendicular Error (Yards)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_qq <- ggplot(residual_data, aes(sample = linear_fit_res)) +
  stat_qq(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_qq_line(color = "firebrick", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "C. Normal Q-Q Plot of Model Residuals",
    subtitle = "Evaluates heavy-tail error behavior across off-target throws",
    x = "Theoretical Quantiles",
    y = "Sample Quantiles"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_long_res <- ggplot(residual_data, aes(x = route_depth_yds, y = long_residual, color = inside)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "seagreen3", "FALSE" = "red"),
    name = "Inside Envelope"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "D. Longitudinal Residuals relative to LOS",
    subtitle = "Positive = Target landed past pre-throw route length | Negative = Target landed short",
    x = "Route Depth Relative to LOS (Yards)",
    y = "Longitudinal Residual (Yards)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

residual_diagnostics <- (p_res_vs_depth | p_res_density) / (p_qq | p_long_res) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Pre-Pass Target Envelope Residual Diagnostics",
    subtitle = "Corridor widths, cushions, and dynamic projections calibrated strictly from pre-throw tracking data."
  )

print(residual_diagnostics)
```

# Code for Other File

```{r}

library(dplyr)

# 1. Load the pre-calibrated parameters
optimal_params <- readRDS("optimal_envelope_parameters.rds") %>%
  select(pass_depth_bin, backward_cushion, corridor_width, frames_ahead)

# 2. Calculate receiver route depth on your new tracking dataset
route_depths <- new_tracking_data %>%
  # Filter down to the players you want to evaluate (e.g., all eligible receivers)
  filter(player_role %in% c("Targeted Receiver", "Receiver")) %>%
  group_by(game_id, play_id, nfl_id) %>%
  summarise(
    # Get receiver X coordinate at the first frame (snap)
    start_x = x_std[global_frame == min(global_frame)],
    # Get receiver X coordinate at the final recorded frame of their route
    end_x = x_std[global_frame == max(global_frame)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate vertical distance covered. abs() handles bidirectional play if not standardized,
    # but assumes x_std is your longitudinal coordinate.
    route_depth_yds = abs(end_x - start_x),
    
    # Map the depth to the exact same factor levels used in your calibration
    pass_depth_bin = cut(
      route_depth_yds, 
      breaks = c(-Inf, 10, 20, 30, Inf),
      labels = c("Short (<10 yds)", "Medium (10-20 yds)", "Deep (20-30 yds)", "Bomb (30+ yds)")
    )
  )

# 3. Join the optimal parameters to the evaluated routes
ready_for_pitch_control <- route_depths %>%
  left_join(optimal_params, by = "pass_depth_bin")

```
